# 2 Baruch Chapter 81 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "So listen, O Israel, and let me teach you, O Jacob. Do not remove from your hearts the way of life."

**2** "Today I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you: that you have before you death and life."

**3** "Choose the way of life and you will live; choose the way of death and you will die."

**4** "For the mercy of the Mighty One endures forever; his power from generation to generation; and his kingdom goes on forever and ever."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
